title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade

title: ASUS Prepares BIOS Updates For AM5 Motherboards, Bringing Optimized Low-Latency Performance For CXMT Memory
content: ASUS is preparing new BIOS updates for its AM5 motherboards that could improve memory latency on selected CXMT-based DDR5 memory modules. ASUS to Bring Optimized Low-Latency on CXMT Memory Through its Latest BIOS Updates for Superior Performance Multiple motherboard vendors have already added support for CXMT-based DDR5 memory modules a while ago. We also saw many mainstream motherboards making new records with CMXT DDR5 memory, and now ASUS is set to add further enhancements for these modules.
